status_vocabulary.supported: mechanism exists on the real consumer path and discriminating evidence exists
status_vocabulary.supported_weak_form_only: only the explicitly weakened proposition is supported
status_vocabulary.partial: mechanism exists for a strict subset of the declared domain
status_vocabulary.not_supported: a known countermodel reaches the consumer with the claimed-false outcome
status_vocabulary.not_established: no mechanism or no evidence either way
status_vocabulary.by_design: follows from absence of any authority-granting consumer
status_vocabulary.supported_historical: supported only by dated historical evidence; PreviousHeadQualified != CurrentHeadQualified

claims.title: Advisory identity
claims.proposition: AgentReview v1 is an advisory review engine; its outputs grant no merge authority.
consumer: consumer publisher (AgentEscala agent-review-publish.yml) publishes a comment; no branch-protection required check is fed by the v1 gate in this repository
required_evidence: no v1 artifact is a required status check or merge input in the declared topology
docs state advisory role
degraded_by: any consumer wiring the v1 gate as a required merge check
limitations: the consumer's branch-protection configuration is outside this repository and was not re-observed in C0

claims.title: Coverage truth
claims.proposition: A file is reported as covered only when the material needed to review it (an observable textual hunk) was admitted into a chunk payload; PathPresent != MaterialReviewed.
required_evidence: RED: non-must_review hunk-less file (binary / mode-only / pure rename / empty new file) ends with gate status passed and file counted covered
GREEN: same input yields the file outside files_covered and a degraded/non-complete coverage visible at the gate
propagation proof through plan -> parse -> synthesize -> gate, not only SemanticChunkPlan
positive control: textual-hunk file in same PR remains covered
degraded_by: payload-level limitations not restated at plan level
limitations: the LLM's own files_reviewed self-report is accepted verbatim by the parser (chunk_result_parser.py:256-279)

claims.title: Semantic claim coverage
claims.proposition: When a structured, admitted claim/must-hold is applicable to the subject, the review reports its coverage in {covered, partial, not_covered, not_applicable}, semantically separate from file coverage.
producer: NONE for structured claims. Existing primitives: payload_cost_model.py:1330-1336 aux_context.semantic_context.must_hold (list[str], no id, first item dropped under budget: chunk_payload_builder.py:504,557-562); schemas.py:92-93 TargetProfile.domain_contracts/review_packs (untyped); schemas.py:170 SemanticChunk.contracts (constant ref list, semantic_chunker.py:424,768-772); chunk_response_contract.py:17-28 finding.contract_id (optional label, never validated)
consumer: NONE: ChunkResponse/ChunkResults/FinalReview/ReviewQualityGate carry no per-claim state (schemas.py:298-305 and downstream)
required_evidence: a structured claim object with stable id admitted from a target-owned artifact
a response slot for per-claim state bound to that id
parser/synthesizer/gate consumption so that not_covered/partial of an applicable claim cannot co-exist with a conclusive approving verdict

fixture preserving AgentEscala #805: composed_24h_same_assignee + only single_shift targets + applicable pair-fidelity must-hold -> material/merge-blocking outcome (owner requirement of record: #221 comment 2026-09-16)
degraded_by: claim present only as PR free text (never transported: no PR title/body in chunk payload)
contracts shape not parseable by v1 flatteners
limitations: Detection that code falsifies a claim remains an LLM hypothesis; only the carriage, state and gate consumption can be deterministic.

Task-contract restriction for this traversal (owner-confirmed 2026-09-30; record: https://github.com/mglpsw/aiops-orchestrator/pull/365#issuecomment-5914381014): free-text PR claims do not become deterministic authority and no generic PR-claim NLP is implemented. This restricts means only; it does not dispose of the #805 requirement.
claims.risk: STOP_OWNER_BOUNDARY likely: closing requires a new structured claim object, a response-contract extension (frozen v1 golden fixtures) and target-side authoring; see 04_EXECUTION_ROADMAP.md V1-C2.
claims.owner_requirement_of_record: #221 comment 2026-09-16: declared claims/relevant must-holds extracted from PR/contract pack; #805 fixture => material/merge-blocking; contracts_context_not_relevant impossible when the claim depends on the selected contract pack; material limitations degrade confidence/coverage
claims.narrowing_status: PENDING_HUMAN_DECISION for any part of the requirement of record not achievable within the traversal's permitted means (#221: the epic grants no waivers)

claims.title: Materiality
claims.proposition: A finding is confirmed only with ObservedChange + ApplicableRelation + ConcreteEvidence + NegativeConsequence + ExactSubjectAboutness; otherwise it must not remain in the confirmed-finding partition.
producer: app/agent_review/finding_normalizer.py:122-227 (only confirm/downgrade site: field presence, speculative wording, placeholder evidence, test-failure source)
consumer: app/agent_review/quality_gate.py:362-408,539-557 (P0/P1 presence checks only; P2/P3 never rechecked)
required_evidence: RED per historical countermodel (CM-CL3-01..06) as recorded model output replayed through parse -> synthesize -> gate
GREEN: each is removed from confirmed_findings with a reason code; the discriminator is the confirmed/risk/rejected partition, not only normalized_verdict
positive control: real contract violation with concrete evidence and demonstrated consequence survives as confirmed at its severity
mutation: removing each new predicate turns its focal test RED
degraded_by: normalizer has no access to hunk text, so aboutness is not checkable without new input (chunk payload or diff)
limitations: the deterministic layer can reject structurally unsupported findings; it cannot prove a stated consequence is true
claims.channel_constraint: v1 has no neutral observation channel: NormalizedRisk (incl. source=downgraded_finding) escalates to approve_with_required_followup (final_synthesizer.py:474-475; quality_gate.py:544-545); rejected_findings yield approve_with_minor_notes (final_synthesizer.py:476). Downgrading a P3 into a risk makes the verdict stricter. Target channel is an open V1-C3 decision.

claims.title: Limitation propagation
claims.proposition: A limitation that prevents evaluating a required obligation makes that obligation not covered and degrades the reported coverage/confidence visible at the gate.
producer: plan-level: semantic_chunker.py (file_context_missing, file_context_fallback_used, must_review_hunk_unavailable, payload_oversize, budget_exhausted)
consumer: plan-level limitations reach the gate through plan.status/files_not_covered (supported)
payload/brief-level limitations: DROPPED — the manifest and brief are not inputs to parse/synthesize/gate (scripts/aiops-review-{parse-chunks,synthesize,quality-gate}.py argparse)
required_evidence: for each limitation class declared blocking-for-an-obligation, a test that the gate outcome for that obligation is not conclusive-approving
explicit classification table: informational vs obligation-degrading
limitations: model self-reported limitations never drive status (schemas.py:372-381) — by design, LLM advisory

claims.title: Non-vacuous blocker qualification / result coverage
claims.proposition: A blocking outcome arises only from an adequately sustained blocker, and a surviving result does not certify coverage it did not receive (UntrustedBlockerCandidate != TrustedBlockingConclusion).
consumer: consumer publisher matrix docs/AGENT_REVIEW_QUALITY_GATE.md:103-125: passed|degraded + changes_requested + manual=false -> conclusive blocking publication
required_evidence: independent reproduction of literal TS1 (CM-CL5-03): ChunkResults schema_id/target_repo mutated after construction via the Python API + valid P1 -> trusted blocker (the #275 trust set is ABSENT on master)
GREEN for literal TS1: a P1 inside result-identity-mismatched ChunkResults (schema_id/target_repo/plan ref) is an untrusted blocker, not a trusted blocking conclusion (OBL-CL5-04)
additional #307 result-coverage countermodel, not TS1: RED P1 on a file the same chunk reported files_not_reviewed -> gate passed/changes_requested/manual=false (CM-CL5-01, REPRODUCED)
additional #307 result-coverage countermodel, not TS1: all files not_reviewed, noncritical, with and without plan -> gate passed/approved (CM-CL5-02, REPRODUCED through the real parser/synthesizer)
mechanism removed -> focal RED; restored -> focal GREEN
bounded mutation over the remaining trust edges
limitations: literal TS1 (removal of chunk_results_schema_mismatch from #275's trust set) is not reachable through the CLI because load_chunk_results rejects schema mismatch on disk (quality_gate.py:151-158); it is reachable via the Python API with mutable models

claims.title: Egress
claims.proposition: WEAK FORM ONLY: L-CHUNK applies regex/blocklist secret redaction plus absolute/home-path redaction before chunk payloads leave the engine; L-LEGACY applies inline regex secret redaction only, with no path redaction. Neither guarantees that raw source or raw repository paths cannot reach inference transport.
consumer: L-CHUNK: consumer wrapper sends each chunk payload whole to Router /v1/chat/completions (full raw git diff block per file + repo-relative paths)

L-LEGACY: github_agent_review.py:1415-1589 (_build_sanitized_bundle: PR title/body :1441-1442, raw paths, full patch for small PRs, <=2000-char head file source for some frontend files), :2037-2102 (build_agent_router_payload), :2128-2157 (call_agent_router_review)
required_evidence: an explicit disposition among #315's options A/B/C
docs no longer state stronger protection than implemented
degraded_by: output_safe_for_llm is a constant True in L-CHUNK (cli.py:109), not a computed property
limitations: a code reviewer must transmit reviewed code to its inference transport; a structural no-source guarantee is incompatible with L-CHUNK's function as designed
